item.title: Australia’s Spilt Milk Festival Confirms 2026 Return
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music news! We've got some exciting updates for you from Down Under. Australia's Spilt Milk festival has officially confirmed its return for 2026!
[Short music transition]
Host: "The festival dropped a teaser video on social media last Friday, featuring members of the public talking about their favorite Aussie music festivals, before cutting to footage of a packed crowd and epic stage production. And the big reveal? Spilt Milk is coming back in 2026! Although, we're still waiting on dates, locations, and the lineup.
[Short music transition]
Host: "This follows a successful 2025 edition, which sold out across all four host cities: Ballarat, Perth, Canberra, and the Gold Coast. Last year's lineup was a real treat, with Kendrick Lamar headlining, alongside Doechii, Dominic Fike, and many more.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Spilt Milk has come a long way since its launch in Canberra back in 2016. It's grown into one of Australia's largest touring festivals, with past performances from big names like Post Malone, Lorde, and Flume. And, interestingly, the 2019 Ballarat event was even Juice WRLD's final live show.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "We can't wait to see what Spilt Milk 2026 has in store. Stay tuned for more updates, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
